name: OpenSRE
description: Diagnoses failed CI runs from the terminal, separates CI-caused from code-caused failures and pushes fixes, as an open-source CLI agent.

skills.name: Investigate failed runs
skills.description: Investigates a CI run the moment it fails, reading logs and testing hypotheses to find the cause.

skills.name: CI cost reporting
skills.description: Reports failure rate, developer hours lost to unreliable CI and how long main stays red.
